name: Ambient Light from Battery Telemetry
description: Tested claim: ambient light level is inferable from battery voltage/current/temperature telemetry (via display auto-brightness power draw). Falsified: no measurable information gain over the prior once display brightness is held fixed or the ambient light sensor baseline is available.
task: ambient light level: dark / dim / bright
limitations: Apparent signal in pilot data was entirely mediated by auto-brightness display power draw, not by any direct physical coupling; with brightness fixed, mutual information estimate fell below the screening threshold.
references: Screening run 2026-07-12, MI estimate 0.02 bits vs threshold 0.1 bits
